column2: a cream cable-knit CROPPED sweater with long sleeves to the wrists and a round neck, the ribbed hem at her waist above the navel; it completely covers the bandeau; the inside back of the neckline is visible behind her neck.

a loose lilac hoodie with long sleeves to the wrists, a kangaroo pocket, a drawstring hood lying flat behind her neck and shoulders (the hood is in the back layer, visible around her neck); the ribbed hem sits at her natural waist; it completely covers her chest and the bandeau.

a white silk blouse with long sleeves to the wrists, a soft pointed collar and small buttons, the hem at the hips; it completely covers the bandeau; the inside back of the collar is visible behind her neck.
a fitted black strapless mini cocktail dress from above the bust to mid-thigh, its straight top edge high enough to cover the bandeau completely; it completely covers the briefs, also at the hips.

a floor-length emerald-green sequined evening gown with thin straps and a soft V neckline and a high side slit on her left leg (viewer's right) showing the leg; the hem reaches the floor around the feet; it completely covers the briefs; the inner back of the gown is visible through the slit and below the hem between her feet.

a yellow floral sundress with wide shoulder straps, a square neckline covering the bandeau completely and a flared skirt ending above the knees; it completely covers the briefs; the inner back of the skirt is visible between her legs below the hem.

a very short textured platinum-blonde pixie cut with a soft side-swept fringe; the hair hugs the head (at most 10 pixels outside her hair cap) and completely covers the cap, also at the temples; ears fully visible; at the back the hair is cropped short at the nape and does NOT hang down beside the jaw or neck.

a fitted camel-colour blazer with long sleeves to the wrists, notch lapels and ONE button at the waist; the lapels form a deep open V neckline from the shoulders down to the button, and inside the V her bare chest shows: those pixels are fully transparent in the front layer (no lining, no shirt, no camel fabric between the lapels); the hem at the hips; the inside back of the collar is visible behind her neck.

a fitted black sleeveless tube top with a straight wide boat neckline from shoulder to shoulder, hem at her natural waist, completely covering the bandeau; over it a cropped dark-burgundy open-knit crochet shrug (bolero) with thin black stripes, covering the shoulders and the upper chest, with long sleeves down to the wrists that flare slightly; through the open crochet holes of the sleeves her arms show (those holes are transparent in the front layer); the inside back of the shrug's neckline is visible behind her neck. IMPORTANT: the front layer is NOT a product shot - it is the garment exactly where it sits on her body in step 1, same size and position, the rest of the canvas transparent.
